تنتهبون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَهِبُونَ (tantahibūna) /tan.ta.hi.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# تُنْتَهَبُونَ (tuntahabūna) /tun.ta.ha.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
